title: Evaluación de la vulnerabilidad ante el efecto del cambio climático: República Bolivariana de Venezuela
organization: Ministry of Popular Power for Ecosocialism (MINEC), with FAO implementation support
temporal_coverage: 2025 assessment; projections for 2021–2040, 2041–2060 and 2061–2080, with 1970–2000 baseline.
methodology: Sectoral projections use two GCMs and SSP2-4.5/SSP5-8.5.
limitations: Full text read on user-uploaded Scribd mirror, not official host.

title: Annual Report 2025: Chapter IV.B, Venezuela
organization: Inter-American Commission on Human Rights (IACHR), Organization of American States
temporal_coverage: Annual human-rights monitoring for 2025; climate-event passages cover the first half of 2025.
methodology: IACHR annual monitoring chapter synthesizes state statements, UN findings and cited reporting.
limitations: Some environmental and event details are attributed to cited sources; this is not a climate-attribution study.

title: Venezuela Situation Report No. 2 (Year-End), 31 December 2024
temporal_coverage: Situation and UNICEF response from 1 January to 31 December 2024; issued 6 February 2025.
methodology: UNICEF country situation report combines humanitarian monitoring and agency response data.
limitations: Agency-reported reach and needs; not a population-wide impact evaluation or climate-attribution analysis.

title: Venezuela Humanitarian Situation Report No. 1 (Mid-Year), 30 June 2025
temporal_coverage: Situation and UNICEF response from 1 January to 30 June 2025; issued 1 August 2025.
methodology: UNICEF country situation report combines humanitarian monitoring and agency response data.
limitations: Agency-reported reach and needs; reported access constraints are contextual, not a causal evaluation.
